ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate over 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to localized punctate spots and distal clusters, resulting in a low macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous solid black mask. Secondary spatial features include four discrete high-intensity circular points near the median notch and dense, complex white/grey clusters localized at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees; the depth of the notch extends roughly 15% into the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entirety of the trailing edge; the contour consists of sharp, irregular peaks and non-uniform valleys isolated against the high-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve characterizing the trailing edge, terminating in acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with epibiont colonization (barnacles) located at the lateral apices of both lobes; four distinct high-intensity punctate clusters are visible near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of sessile organisms (barnacles) forming high-relief clusters at the outer lateral boundaries of both lobes.
